actions.label: Write a letter
actions.description: File a letter only your person can answer.
actions.agent: File a letter to this agent's person: a request only they can answer, with the options their answer picks from. The answer comes back to the sender.
actions.when: Pick this to ask the person something only they can answer, once per question; a send with the same dedupeKey returns the letter already filed.

errors.means: A field broke a letter rule, such as a missing whyOnlyYou or a letter code in sender text; the text names the field.
errors.fix: Fix that field as the text says, then send again.

errors.means: Ouro can't tell who this agent's person is: no family friend record, or several, names this machine's owner.
errors.fix: Have the person run `ouro friend dedupe --apply`, or link their record to this machine, then send again.

errors.means: The Ouro daemon, which keeps the letters, isn't running, so nothing was read or filed.
errors.fix: Start it with `ouro up`, then call again.

errors.means: The call passed an input mailbox_send doesn't take, such as to or from, which Ouro sets; the text names it.
errors.fix: Call it again with only the inputs its schema lists.

errors.means: An input is missing or has the wrong type or value; the text names it and what it takes.
errors.fix: Call it again with that input as its schema describes.

errors.means: No agent bundle by that name is on this machine, so there are no letters to read or file.
errors.fix: Name an agent this machine has; `ouro status` lists them.

kind.label: Kind
kind.description: decide: pick one of 2 to 5 options; do: a task only they can do; accept: approve finished work; know: something they should know.

subject.label: Subject
subject.description: What is asked, in one line of at most 80 characters.

whyOnlyYou.label: Why only you
whyOnlyYou.description: Why only the person can answer, at most 200 characters; required unless kind is know.

body.label: Details
body.description: What the person needs to answer, in Markdown, at most 4,000 characters.

options.label: Options
options.description: For a decide letter only: 2 to 5 options, each { label, effect }. Labels are words, without dashes, each its own.

of.label: Option
of.description: One answer the person can pick.

label.label: Label
label.description: The option's words, at most 40 characters.

effect.label: Effect
effect.description: What happens when the person picks it, at most 160 characters.

links.label: Links
links.description: Pages the person may want while answering, at most 10, each { label, url }.

dedupeKey.label: Dedupe key
dedupeKey.description: A key of yours for this question: a send with a key you used before returns that letter instead of filing another.

holdUntil.label: Hold until
holdUntil.description: "interactive" to hold it for a session with the person, or an ISO time.

expiresAt.label: Expires
expiresAt.description: An ISO time after which the question is moot, such as 2026-12-01T17:00:00Z.

lane.label: Lane
lane.description: Where you ask from, such as a desk task path, so the person knows who waits.

outcome.label: Outcome
outcome.description: needs-human when a new letter was filed, done when the send matched a letter already filed, preview on a dry run.

id.label: Letter
id.description: The letter's id, the receipt; empty on a dry run.

code.label: Code
code.description: The letter's code, such as L7; empty on a dry run.

state.label: State
state.description: waiting, answered, withdrawn or expired; Ouro derives it from the letter's events.

actions.label: Letters
actions.description: List the letters waiting for you.
actions.agent: List the letters this agent's person has been sent that still wait for an answer, oldest first, or every letter with all. Read only.
actions.when: Pick this to see which letters still wait for the person's answer before filing another; it only reads.

errors.means: The Ouro daemon, which keeps the letters, isn't running, so nothing was read or filed.
errors.fix: Start it with `ouro up`, then call again.

errors.means: The call passed an input mailbox_list doesn't take, such as to or from, which Ouro sets; the text names it.
errors.fix: Call it again with only the inputs its schema lists.

errors.means: An input is missing or has the wrong type or value; the text names it and what it takes.
errors.fix: Call it again with that input as its schema describes.

errors.means: No agent bundle by that name is on this machine, so there are no letters to read or file.
errors.fix: Name an agent this machine has; `ouro status` lists them.

all.label: All
all.description: List answered, withdrawn and expired letters too.

mine.label: Mine
mine.description: Only the letters this agent filed.

outcome.label: Outcome
outcome.description: done, when the pile was read.

count.label: Letters
count.description: How many letters the listing holds.

listing.label: Letters
listing.description: One letter per line, oldest first: code, state, age and subject; empty when none match.

actions.label: Read a letter
actions.description: Read one letter and what has happened to it.
actions.agent: Read one letter by id or code: what it asks, its options, its state and every event, such as when it was seen. Read only.
actions.when: Pick this when you hold a letter's id or code and want its state or answer; it only reads.

errors.means: No letter has that id or code.
errors.fix: Find it with mailbox_list (all: true lists closed letters too), then call again with its id or code.

errors.means: The Ouro daemon, which keeps the letters, isn't running, so nothing was read or filed.
errors.fix: Start it with `ouro up`, then call again.

errors.means: The call passed an input mailbox_read doesn't take, such as to or from, which Ouro sets; the text names it.
errors.fix: Call it again with only the inputs its schema lists.

errors.means: An input is missing or has the wrong type or value; the text names it and what it takes.
errors.fix: Call it again with that input as its schema describes.

errors.means: No agent bundle by that name is on this machine, so there are no letters to read or file.
errors.fix: Name an agent this machine has; `ouro status` lists them.

letter.label: Letter
letter.description: The letter's id (ltr_…) or its code (L7).

outcome.label: Outcome
outcome.description: done, when the letter was read.

state.label: State
state.description: waiting, answered, withdrawn or expired; Ouro derives it from the letter's events.

letter.label: Letter
letter.description: The letter as filed, as JSON.

events.label: Events
events.description: What has happened to it, one event per line, oldest first: time and what happened.

actions.label: Wait for an answer
actions.description: Wait until a letter is answered or closed.
actions.agent: Block until a letter leaves waiting or the timeout ends, then return its state and a cursor to pass next time. Read only.
actions.when: Pick this only when your caller must block on the answer; otherwise the answer arrives in the session that asked.

errors.means: No letter has that id or code.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.description: The cursor the last wait returned; events after it count.

outcome.label: Outcome
outcome.description: done when the letter has left waiting or has an event past the cursor, timeout when nothing changed.

state.label: State
state.description: waiting, answered, withdrawn or expired; Ouro derives it from the letter's events.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.description: How many events the letter has; pass it to the next wait.

actions.label: Withdraw a letter
actions.description: Take back a letter you filed.
actions.agent: Take back a waiting letter this agent filed, with the reason, so the person stops seeing it.
actions.when: Pick this when a letter you filed no longer needs an answer, such as when the question became moot.

errors.means: No letter has that id or code.
errors.fix: Find it with mailbox_list (all: true lists closed letters too), then call again with its id or code.

errors.means: Another agent filed this letter, and only the agent that filed a letter may withdraw it.
errors.fix: Leave it, or ask the agent that filed it.

errors.means: The letter is already answered, withdrawn or expired.
errors.fix: Read it with mailbox_read; there is nothing to withdraw.

errors.means: The Ouro daemon, which keeps the letters, isn't running, so nothing was read or filed.
errors.fix: Start it with `ouro up`, then call again.

errors.means: The call passed an input mailbox_withdraw doesn't take, such as to or from, which Ouro sets; the text names it.
errors.fix: Call it again with only the inputs its schema lists.

errors.fix: Call it again with that input as its schema describes.

letter.label: Letter
letter.description: The letter's id (ltr_…) or its code (L7).

reason.label: Reason
reason.description: Why it no longer needs an answer, in one line.

outcome.label: Outcome
outcome.description: done, when the letter was withdrawn; preview on a dry run, which checks the withdraw and writes nothing.

state.label: State
state.description: waiting, answered, withdrawn or expired; Ouro derives it from the letter's events.

actions.label: Deliver a letter
actions.description: Send a letter to your chat now.
actions.agent: Ask Ouro to send a waiting letter to the person's own chat now, rendered by Ouro, and record that it was delivered.
actions.when: Pick this when you judge the person should see a waiting letter now; Ouro writes the text and picks the chat.

errors.means: The letter was filed before the person had an answering handle, so Ouro has no chat to send it to.
errors.fix: Leave the letter waiting; once the person sets a handle with `ouro mailbox handle set`, letters filed after that can be delivered.

errors.means: The letter is already answered, withdrawn or expired.
errors.fix: Nothing to deliver; read the letter to see how it closed.

errors.means: The letter is already in the person's chat; each letter goes there once.
errors.fix: Wait for the answer with mailbox_wait.

errors.means: This daemon has no chat to send through.
errors.fix: Leave the letter waiting; the person reads it in their mailbox.

errors.means: The message never reached the chat; the letter stays waiting.
errors.fix: Deliver it again once the cause the refusal names is fixed.

errors.means: The send failed after it may have reached the chat, so Ouro counts the letter as delivered and won't send it twice.
errors.fix: Wait for the answer with mailbox_wait; the letter is in the person's mailbox either way.

errors.means: The letter went to the chat, but Ouro couldn't record that.
errors.fix: Leave it; delivering again would send it twice.

errors.means: No letter has that id or code.
errors.fix: Find it with mailbox_list (all: true lists closed letters too), then call again with its id or code.

errors.means: The Ouro daemon, which keeps the letters, isn't running, so nothing was read or filed.

text.label: Text
text.description: On a dry run, the letter as the person will read it.

actions.description: Answer a letter by picking one of its options.
actions.agent: The person's own answer to a letter.

personOnly.reason: You can't answer a letter for the person; only they can
personOnly.how: by replying to the letter in their chat, such as "L7 2"
